cells.text: In production with real customers or real money moving.

Recurring production: Recurring operation with identified clients, routes, products or material operator-reported volume.; Scale + recovery: Recurring scale plus public stress, correction, recovery, default or legacy-retirement evidence.
in production but restricted: one client, small volumes, invite-only, or open only to a bank's own eligible clients (Katie's definition, 2026-10-19)
Bounded live: Completed transaction or live product with a narrow client, product, jurisdiction or event perimeter.
Test or pilot with real participants, not production.
Pilot / test: Controlled experiment, sandbox, proof of concept or trial.
Announced, agreement signed, or planned; no evidence of it running.
Announced build: Roadmap, intended launch, consortium exploration or conditional approval; not yet an operating receipt.
A regulatory proposal (not final).
The library and a web check found no evidence (for bank cells, also library code M0/M1).

No public receipt: No institution-specific public research, build or operating receipt located for this capability.; Research / thesis: Institution-authored analysis, strategy or forecast without a corresponding operating commitment.
research, statements or hiring only; nothing built yet (the hub's M1)
